_comment: Copy to ~/.hapi/pr-merge-policy.json. Chip status stays health-only; this overlay picks lane A (maintainer) vs B (self-merge). Auto-B = size caps on product files only (*.test.* / *.spec.* / __tests__ excluded; pure test-only PRs stay auto-B). Product paths OK under caps. Oversized / judgment-call PRs promote via low-impact label or allow_pr_numbers. Path-kind reject (product_paths) retired 2026-08-09.
